pattern: for each card exiled this way , the player who exiled it may play it {d:Dur}
subject: none

examples.text: Target opponent looks at the top card of your library, then exiles it face down. You look at the top three cards of their library, then exile them face down. For each card exiled this way, the player who exiled it may play it for as long as it remains exiled.
{2}{U}, {T}: Target opponent looks at the top card of your library, then exiles it face down. For each card exiled this way, the player who exiled it may play it this turn.
